verdict.rationale: dlt provides a dedicated dbt runner that executes dbt models directly within the same pipeline script right after data loading, rather than via an external schedule, plus dltHub's dbt generator auto-creates staging/fact models from the freshly-inferred pipeline schema. This directly matches the story of transformations running against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user testimony confirming this in-pipeline dbt-run pattern works reliably in production, and more detail on failure/ordering guarantees between load and transform steps.
